title: RunR runtime catalog, schema 1
description: The runtimes (executors) RunR offers, as manifests: one entry per runtimes/<id>/runtime.yaml of the repository the catalog was built from. Published as the OCI artifact ghcr.io/brf-tech/runr/runtime-catalog:stable (one layer of application/vnd.runr.runtime-catalog.v1+json, at most 8 MiB), signed with cosign. Each manifest is validated against RunR's runtime schema (api/resources/runtimes/runtime.schema.json of BRF-Tech/runr) by the RunR instance that reads it. lib/catalog.jq catalog_problems checks what this schema cannot: unique ids and paths, the manifest's id = the directory of its path, the catalog order, the files of dockerfile versions (present, at most 900 KB together), unique patch ids, id = <runtime>-<version>-<tag>, the tag a patch of the version, a patch's runtime in the catalog, at most 5 patches per runtime version.

schema.description: The schema version of the document.

generated_at.description: When this version of the catalog was built.

source.description: Where the catalog was built from.

revision.description: The commit the catalog was built from.

runtimes.description: One entry per runtimes/<id>/runtime.yaml: python, nodejs, go, php, tensorflow, pytorch first (those present), then the rest by path.

patches.description: Patches of the catalog's own runtime images, as patch-feed v1 patches[] entries (schema/patch-feed.v1.json). The official catalog leaves it empty: BRF-Tech's patches are in the patch feed.

path.description: The manifest's path in the repository: runtimes/<id>/runtime.yaml.

manifest.description: The runtime.yaml as JSON (YAML 1.2 core schema: quoted versions stay strings), every "@file" of build.files replaced by the content of that file. Validated against RunR's runtime schema by the instance that reads it.

files.description: Only for a runtime with a version that names a dockerfile: every regular file of the runtime's directory but runtime.yaml (not recursive), by name; the build context RunR builds the image from in each region. Names are ConfigMap keys; at most 50 files and 900 KB together.

time.description: A UTC time to the second.

level.description: How urgent the patch is: routine (rebuilds, upstream releases), security, critical, zero-day.

reason.description: Why the patch exists, short, in English and Turkish.

patch.description: A patch-feed v1 patches[] entry (schema/patch-feed.v1.json), of a runtime of this catalog.

runtime.description: A runtime of this catalog (its id).

version.description: The floating tag the patch belongs to (major.minor).

tag.description: The immutable patch tag: <full upstream version>-r<n>.

image.description: The image repository, without a tag.

digest.description: The digest of the patch's image index.

cves.description: The vulnerabilities the patch fixes: CVE or GHSA ids.

upstream.description: The upstream release the image runs: "Lua 5.4.7".

deadline_at.description: When instances must run the patch (required for critical and zero-day).
